title: refactor(driver-sql): the sql-driver codemod retires 15 facade-gate exception rows (knex calls, spelled return types, comments in parameters, accessors, computed defaults, the logger default) (#30147 phase 2a)
body:

_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBWMEECkfNfe2VjW9rMJG3n7)_

Part of #30147 (phase 2a of 2a-2d: the sql-driver codemod learns six mechanisms and retires 15 exception rows. 2b, 2c and 2d, then the phase 3 measurement, stay open on the card.)

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么:`scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs` 新增六种机制(knex 调用、写出返回类型、参数列表里的注释、getter、计算型参数默认值、`logger` 字段默认值),用它重新生成 `sql-driver.ts` 和 9 个模块(新增 `sql-driver-schema-introspection.ts`),登记表删去 15 条 sql-driver.ts 例外(88 → 73)。
- 为什么改:#30147 要求 codemod 自己移走这些"能力不足"的例外,而不是手改生成结果。
- 风险与回滚:方法体逐字节不变(171/171),公开 `.d.ts` 与 base 逐字节相同;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:codemod 里四张新表 `RECEIVER_FREE_FIELDS` / `EXPLICIT_RETURN_TYPES` / `MOVED_ACCESSORS` / `MOVED_FIELD_DEFAULTS`,以及 `verify` 里对应的撤销逻辑。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs --verify --base 21510bba`,预期 `171/171 moved bodies identical to base`、`sql-driver.ts 18334 -> 10717 lines`,退出 0;`node scripts/check-facade-delegation-only.mjs` 打印 73 条具名例外,退出 0。
- 需要你做的:无,席位审阅并落地。

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What changes

The sql-driver codemod (`scripts/codemod-split-sql-driver.mjs`) learns six mechanisms. Each one is regenerated from the unsplit `sql-driver.ts` at `21510bba` and re-proved by `--verify` (undoing the split rebuilds the base byte for byte). No generated file is edited by hand.

| mechanism | table or rule | members it moves |
|:--|:--|:--|
| a body may call `this.knex(...)` | `RECEIVER_FREE_FIELDS` (a Knex instance is the `function knex(tableName, options)` closure, which reads `knex.context`, never `this`) | `listPhysicalColumns`, `explainUnkeyableTextColumn`, `explainHashShadowDuplicate` (and `getBuilder`'s field-call half) |
| the stub writes the return type the base leaves inferred | `EXPLICIT_RETURN_TYPES` (types copied from `dist/index.d.ts` built at base) | `getBuilder`, `applyFilters`, `ensureDatabaseExists`, `createDatabase` |
| a comment between the parentheses moves with the base list verbatim | rule (the `comment-in-parameters` stay reason is gone) | `assertOperatorAppliesToColumn` |
| a get accessor keeps its signature; its body moves | `MOVED_ACCESSORS` | `insertReturnsStoredRows`, `dateGranularityCapabilities`, `supportsWalJournal`, `dialectName` |
| a computed parameter default is written optional on the stub (`nowMs?: number`) and stays where the body is | rule (the gate's own data-default reading, mirrored) | `rotateShards`, `ensureRotation` (hand-series stubs: the default stays in the seam function) |
| a field initializer becomes a facet member typed as the field | `MOVED_FIELD_DEFAULTS` (instance fields only) | `logger` |

`sql-driver.ts` goes from 10,979 to 10,717 lines. Moved bodies go from 158 to 171.

Registry (`scripts/facade-delegation-registry.json`): the 15 rows those members held are deleted (the gate refuses a row whose member is already a delegation). Five rows that stay get their reason rewritten for the half that remains:

- `applyFilterCondition`: inferred-return-type only (2d).
- `ensureShardTable` and `initObjects`: path-reader only (their knex half is retired).
- `get supports`: an accessor whose object type the base leaves inferred, with a docblock on each key.
- `static DIALECT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT`: a static initializer runs while the class is evaluated, so a facet call there could meet its module in the temporal dead zone.

| card | before | after |
|:--|--:|--:|
| #30020 | 17 | 17 |
| #30054 | 16 | 16 |
| #30055 | 6 | 6 |
| #30147 | 49 | 34 (sql-driver.ts 27 → 12) |
| total | 88 | 73 |

`scripts/check-tenant-chokepoint.mjs` lists the new `sql-driver-schema-introspection.ts` in `DECLARED_WATCH_HINTS`, as its self-test requires for every scanned module.

## Tests

- The codemod's `--self-test` gains a sixth pinned battery, "codemod-limit retirements (#30147)", with 31 cases: each mechanism moves only when its table names it; the generated text; two runs give one tree; the generated split proves; one edit per mechanism fails the proof (an unlisted return type, an edited written type, an edited comment, an edited getter body, an optional parameter spelled with another type, a facet member or seam that drops the default, a missing seam, an edited initializer, a field calling another member); every stale or wrong table row refuses. 98 cases in 6 batteries pass (67 in 5 before). The battery floor goes from 5 to 6.
- No test file changes. The suites below ran at base `f2a9007e` and at head; the counts are equal.

| suite | base | head |
|:--|:--|:--|
| driver-sql (`vitest run`) | 238 files passed, 12 skipped; 3,859 passed, 216 skipped | the same |
| driver-turso (subclasses `SqlDriver`) | 97 files; 2,514 passed, 34 skipped | the same |
| driver-sqlite-wasm (subclasses `SqlDriver`) | 40 files; 750 passed | the same |
| cli by-path pins (9 files: generate-* pins, `clean.operator-text-21418`, migrate, schema-migrate) | 9 files; 116 passed | the same |
| types / metadata / metadata-protocol by-path tests, spec `check-liveness.test` | 53 / 11 / 33 / 74 passed | the same |

## Acceptance notes

- The four written return types came from the base's declaration output (`dist/index.d.ts` of `@objectstack/driver-sql` built at base), not from reading the source.
- `get supports` and `static DIALECT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT` stay on #30147 with no sub-phase planned yet; 2b-2d cover the path-reader rows, `createColumn` and `applyFilterCondition`.
- No changeset, as #30139 (`skip-changeset`): no published behaviour or surface changes (the public `.d.ts` is byte-identical).
